long_but_definitional.sortPair_map: Seventeen lines of PURE CASE EXHAUSTION: one case split on the order of the pair, and in the second case two further splits on the order of the mapped entries, each of the resulting cases closed by rewriting the two conditionals, one of them by antisymmetry and one by contradiction of two refuted comparisons.  Its length measures the number of cases, not the amount of work, so the line bound is the wrong instrument here.  The exception is listed rather than the bound raised, so that it is visible and countable; test_census.py requires this list to stay at or below one entry.

note: The FW-DEF census of this rung, TOTAL over every theorem of the package. The four classes are rung six's, with rung six's meanings. RECONSTRUCTION: not this rung's work, reproduced verbatim under a pin -- every theorem of Kernel.lean; IsoKernel.lean reconstructs definitions only and carries no theorem. DEFINITION: true by unfolding, by rfl, by a projection, by one rewrite, by kernel computation over concrete regimes and maps, or by pure case exhaustion; never counted as content. THIN: one genuine step, or a direct corollary of a neighbour; counted apart from CONTENT so the headline is not inflated by one-liners. CONTENT: everything else. The rule applied to the inductions over histories is rung seven's, stated there against rung six's precedent: an induction whose step needs a case analysis on the shape of the step is CONTENT (changes_counted, growths_counted, rest_counted); one closed by a step lemma and arithmetic alone is THIN (clean_replay, still_of_no_changes, whose only case split is on whether the step changed the regime). clean_step is a six-way case exhaustion in which four cases re-establish the well-formedness conjuncts through the step's guard, the membership of a deduplicating insertion, or the reading of a lengthened list of forms; that is more than a length rewrite per case, and it is CONTENT, as rung seven classed naming_step. length_le_of_nodup_sub is an induction over the first list whose step carries a second induction, removing one occurrence by hand; it is CONTENT. insts_le, rules_le and reqs_le each apply count_le_of_inv once, with a left inverse read off the sealed structure's inverse fields and the source's well-formedness; THIN. The seven countermodels of Counter.lean are closed by kernel computation over concrete regimes and concrete maps and are DEFINITION, however many decide calls they spell out; each is under the line bound. range_nodup was not named in the frozen prediction: the library's statement that the admitted range holds no index twice reaches Classical.choice, and it was proved again after the first compile found that; it is recorded as unpredicted native work, THIN. Seven statements are credited, not counted as new to the run: replayE_cons and insertNew_grows (rungs six and seven), changes_counted (rung six; rung five's size_counts_changes), step_parts, growths_counted and rest_counted (rung seven), and getD_append_lt (rung five). test_census.py checks this file is total over the package in both directions, that no row classed DEFINITION has a long proof outside long_but_definitional, and that the classes here are scored against the frozen prediction in PREDICTIONS.md.
